messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw a 2-3x tail latency spike on TP fused-attn when seq_len > 4096 during the canary. Symptoms point at an all-reduce blowup combined with KV-cache thrash. Attaching the short profiler dump below.
sophia: what does the profiler show? which kernel path got picked?
alex: snippet from the run (condensed):
```text
seq=4096 batch=1 tp=2
kernel_chosen: fused_flash_attn_qkv_fallback_comm_unfriendly
allreduce_ms: median=11.2 p95=46.9
kvcache_miss_ratio: 0.28 at step boundaries
cpu-spin / cuda-stall correlation high around allreduce
```
ryan: that kernel name stands out — kernel-picker probably favored memory-friendly fused path but it does lots of cross-tensor copies, causing huge allreduce bytes. We need a comm-cost term in the scoring.
sophia: also noticed batching heuristic didn't prefetch/merge KV windows for consecutive queries; we ended up with more small allgathers rather than a single big one (worse for TP bandwidth).
infra-bot: deploy-canary: rolling canary started for models/roberta-3b @eng-runtime
alex: quick mitigation proposed: force comm-optimized kernel for tp>1 && seq>2048 (trade a tiny single-GPU perf for stable multi-gpu behavior). Patch ready in my branch.
sophia: that should avoid the spike. can we also increase overlap aggressiveness so compute starts while reduce is in-flight? Add an async-allreduce flag gated by kvcache_miss_ratio.
zhen: can we emit metric names so SRE can alert? Suggest: `kvcache_miss_ratio`, `allreduce_bytes_per_step`, `allreduce_overlap_util`.
ryan: short-term plan: roll the kernel-force to 10% canary, watch `latency.p95`, `allreduce_ms.p95` and `kvcache_miss_ratio`. Medium-term: update kernel-scoring to include estimated allreduce_bytes and prefer scatter-friendly kernels when batch==1 and tp>1.
alex: I'll open PR with the canary toggle + metric hooks. PR will include a small test harness command to reproduce: 
```bash
python -m perf_runner --model roberta-3b --seq 4096 --tp 2 --batch 1 --repeat 50 --trace perf.json
```
sophia: running microbench on p4dn x2 now. will attach flamegraph + nvprof traces to the PR.
ryan: also add an e2e regression test that simulates kvcache boundary (hot/cold alternation) so this doesn't regress again.
alex: agree. tagging @sophia and @ryan to own telemetry + bench job. After 10% looks good, we'll widen to 50% before full rollout.
sophia: quick note — the forced kernel patch causes ~3% perf loss for seq<1024, but that's acceptable for now vs 2-3x tail spikes.
zhen: adding alert: fire if `allreduce_ms.p95` increases >30% on canary hosts for 5m.
ryan: can we also consider batching heuristic tweak: prefer micro-batching (2 queries) to amortize allreduce on short queries instead of single huge kernel that spikes for long seqs?
alex: good idea. I'll add a flag `tp_amortize_allreduce=true` behind a feature flag.
sophia: LGTM. I'll post updates in #eng-runtime once bench artifacts upload. :thinking:
